title: Solana CA-first real holder data cleaning pilot
objective: Using the existing read-only Helius boundary only, run a fixed 5–10 public Solana CA pilot that advances from mint/metadata/token-account counts to full token-account enumeration, owner aggregation, cleaning classification, supply accounting, raw/cleaned universes, concentration metrics, CaScanResponseV1 mapping, and a real-data gap matrix. No new providers, no auto-discovery, no production DB, no SOL-E2E expansion.
forbidden_actions: Do not add DexScreener, GMGN, Birdeye, Rugcheck, or any non-Helius provider.
Do not fall back to public Solana RPC.
Do not auto-discover or dynamically add CAs beyond the fixed input manifest.
Do not enable cron, scheduler, queue, or background workers.
Do not write production PostgreSQL or Redis.
Do not trade, sign, or handle private keys.
Do not log or commit API keys, credential-bearing URLs, raw headers, cookies, or unscrubbed provider payloads.
Do not modify main, force-push, or rewrite history.
Do not implement Pump decode, creator history, Dev sell, funding clusters, or wallet PnL.
